title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Divya discovers Karna's role in Parvathy's murder with Vetri's evidence. Determined to expose him, she pretends to be possessed by Parvathy's spirit and observes his reaction.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Manjamalai arrives with the elders to bring Pechi back home. Before letting her go, Mayandi demands a firm guarantee that she will live there with self-respect and dignity.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
episodeTitle: Lakshmi Gets New Shoes for Walking
description: Hurt by Ragavan's mockery over wearing his old shoes, Suresh and Bagyaraj buy Lakshmi a new pair. She then proudly flaunts them before Ragavan, leaving him irritated.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel rejects hosting Suganya's function at Muthuvel's house. Later, Senthil requests that Kathir let him join his travel company as a partner.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Thenmozhi clashes with Chandayatha's mother over Nila, prompting Nadesan to translate. After a room feud, Cheran restores peace while Vannathi breeds new envy.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
episodeTitle: Rekha Hints at Muthu to Step Away
description: Meena clashes with Chandra when she blames Muthu for humiliating Sathya. Rekha confronts Muthu and indirectly urges him to step aside for Sathya's growth and a better future.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Aishwarya trembles, taking a file as Sethupathi enters. Meanwhile, Sethupathi apologises to Tamizhselvi and leaves Azhagar with her before the Chennai trip, bringing joy to all.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
episodeTitle: Kasthuri Steps Into a New Beginning
description: Kasthuri's mother and Jaganathan visit Karikalan to register her marriage with Karthik. Madhu is touched by Arjun's selfless kindness towards a struggling mother in public.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy's family celebrates high profits post-UPI, yet he denies Indhira credit. Later, Indhira tracks Shanmugam and Abhi, while Ganesan confronts Kandhasamy.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 10: Eviction Free Pass Is Here!
description: Ansar’s ratings raise eyebrows, while kitchen drama brings Anandhi to tears. As physical tussles erupt in the cheese task for the pass, Shama changes the least deserving list.
